description: File a request for an object that is not in the library so it can be added; it is the only tool here that writes anything. Use it only after find_geometry and find_by_dimensions found nothing suitable; do not use it to ask questions or to request changes to existing objects. Each call stores exactly one new request in the owner's private inbox and nothing is published, so calling twice files two requests. Stored: the text, the optional contact, the time and the client type; no IP address. There is no reply unless a contact is given. The site accepts at most 300 requests a day across all callers; beyond that the call returns an error and nothing is stored.

contact.description: Email or handle for a reply; include only if the person asked to be contacted.

text.description: Plain description: exact model or part number if known, what it must fit or mate with, which features matter, and any sizes already known.

name: request_object

ok.description: True when the request was stored.

title: Request an object the library lacks
